title.en: Shenzhen Bay: Rinse the Electronics Smell

text.cn: 海边骑行道很长，晚风把华强北的塑料味吹淡一点。对面有人直播「湾区日落」，你只想把手机亮度调低。
text.en: The sea bike path is long. Evening wind dilutes Huaqiangbei plastic smell. Someone livestreams “bay sunset”; you just want lower screen brightness.
Bike the bay; clock out at sunset.

feedback.cn: 肺像被冲洗过。你暂时原谅了所有闸机。
feedback.en: Lungs feel rinsed. You briefly forgive every gate.

text.cn: 草地上坐着发呆：高级的什么都不做。
text.en: Sit on grass and zone out: premium doing-nothing.

feedback.cn: 发呆成功。有人问你是不是在冥想——你其实在想晚饭。
feedback.en: Zoning succeeds. Someone asks if you’re meditating — you’re thinking about dinner.

feedback.cn: 眼睛进沙。浪漫减分，现实加分。

text.cn: 深圳湾日结束。海还在，焦虑轻了一点。
text.en: Bay day ends. Sea remains; anxiety slightly lighter.
